root_cause.text: The `hid-appletb-kbd` teardown path freed the backlight device reference before fully quiescing the inactivity timer and HID callbacks, leaving `appletb_kbd->inactivity_timer` and late `.event` re-arming able to access a `backlight_device` that had already been released.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves `hid_hw_close()/hid_hw_stop()` before backlight cleanup and changes `put_device(&kbd->backlight_dev->dev); timer_delete_sync(&kbd->inactivity_timer);` to `timer_delete_sync(&kbd->inactivity_timer); put_device(&kbd->backlight_dev->dev);`, matching the described two UAF windows where the timer/`reset_inactivity_timer()` could run after the backlight device was freed.

intent_record.intent_summary: Reorder probe-failure cleanup to stop the HID device first and safely delete the inactivity timer before dropping the backlight device reference.
intent_record.what: In the error-handling path of `appletb_kbd_probe()`, the cleanup sequence was reordered: the `backlight_dev` block was moved from before `hid_hw_close(hdev)` to after `hid_hw_stop(hdev)`, and within that block the calls were swapped so `timer_delete_sync(&kbd->inactivity_timer)` now runs before `put_device(&kbd->backlight_dev->dev)`.
intent_record.how: This changes teardown ordering during probe failure so the inactivity timer is fully synchronized and deleted before the backlight device reference is released, and only after the HID hardware has been closed and stopped. It reduces the risk of the timer or cleanup logic accessing resources after they have been torn down.

intent_record.intent_summary: Reorder appletb keyboard teardown to stop HID hardware earlier and delete the inactivity timer before releasing the backlight device.
intent_record.what: In appletb_kbd_remove(), the calls to hid_hw_close(hdev) and hid_hw_stop(hdev) were moved to occur immediately after input_unregister_handler(&kbd->inp_handler) and before the backlight_dev cleanup block. Within the backlight_dev block, timer_delete_sync(&kbd->inactivity_timer) was moved before put_device(&kbd->backlight_dev->dev).
intent_record.how: The removal path now stops and closes the HID hardware earlier, before releasing the backlight device reference and after unregistering the input handler. It also ensures the inactivity timer is synchronously deleted before the backlight device is put, reducing the chance of the timer running against partially torn-down device state.
